title: Hunts FH-044T: Apply the edition migrations and walk one pilot Trail through a release with real printed codes

source.ref: Split from FH-044S (2026-11-16): the release screen, import doors, earlier-edition reads and the 7-day grace rule shipped dark; what an agent cannot do moved here.

detail: Requires FH-044S. Owner role: people (the Database owner, then an Operator), not an agent: (1) apply supabase/migrations/20270346082000_hunt_teams_editions.sql and then 20270346085000_hunt_edition_grace.sql through the serialized gate, and confirm supabase/tests/hunt_editions.test.sql and supabase/tests/hunt_edition_grace.test.sql pass in db-tests; (2) with HUNTS_AUTHORING_ENABLED and HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED on in a preview, release a second edition of one pilot Trail from the editor and confirm each old printed code opens the right stop, a dropped place's code credits nothing, a run started on the first edition still checks in on it inside the 7 days, and is refused after them; (3) write the record of that walk to docs/hunts/EDITION-RELEASE-WALK.md. Production switches stay OFF until this passes.
